body: From the DM-174 review (orchestrator): the `record_attempt_metrics` and `record_run_metrics` descriptions in src/mcp/tools/metrics.ts should say that `handoff_check` is server-derived and refused, and that `coordination_defect` must cite a run record. docs/architecture.md says checks are recorded when a submission is accepted or rejected; failAttempt on a submitted attempt records them too. Derived checks take 4 of the 2,000-entry per-run cap for each reviewed submission.
